title: The Bell (The Cosmic Hymn)
summary: Following the mysterious chime that echoed through the evening clouds, the young prince and the poor widow's boy pursued the sacred melody through different forest paths....
full_text:
Following the mysterious chime that echoed through the evening clouds, the young prince and the poor widow's boy pursued the sacred melody through different forest paths.

When they met at the summit of the coastal cliff at the moment of sunset, they discovered that the divine bell was the living harmony of nature itself: the roar of the ocean, the whisper of the pines, and the boundless canopy of heaven united in praise of the Almighty.
moral: The prince and the pauper stand as equals before the majestic temple of creation.
